title: Neural Circuit Parameter Prediction for Efficient Quantum Data Loading
problem: Quantum data loading—encoding classical data into quantum states—is a critical bottleneck in quantum machine learning; existing methods achieve high per-sample accuracy but lack efficiency for large-scale batch loading.
motivation: Quantum machine learning has potential to outperform classical ML but practical deployment requires efficient batch data encoding; inefficient data loading limits QML applicability to large datasets.
method: Proposes Neural Circuit Parameter Prediction using classical deep neural networks to predict parameterized quantum circuit parameters directly from input data; leverages batch inference capability of DNNs; introduces real-valued circuit parameterization and three-phase training strategy for improved efficiency.
key_novelty: DNN-based parameter prediction for quantum circuits enabling efficient batch quantum data loading.
contributions: Neural Circuit Parameter Prediction methodology for batch-efficient quantum data loading
Three-phase training strategy improving training efficiency and accuracy
17.31% infidelity improvement and 108x speedup versus existing methods on MNIST
limitations: Evaluation limited to MNIST; scalability to large-scale datasets and deployment on real quantum hardware not demonstrated; assumes ideal quantum simulation.
